description: Database schema initialization script for a historical event trivia game, setting up tables for events, clues, and game sessions with relevant indexes and extensions.
calls: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pgcrypto
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.events
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_events_month_day
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.clues
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_clues_event_order
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.game_sessions
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_game_sessions_event
